zh.headline: Anthropic上市首日破发，AI板块蒸发4万亿
headline_alt: Claude参与证明黎曼猜想引数学界激辩
巨头转向：苹果自研Agent、英伟达押注扩散模型
zh.observation: 今天的核心信号是“估值与能力同时被重新定价”：Anthropic 上市首日破发、纳指回吐全年涨幅，说明资本市场对 AI 的定价开始从叙事转向现金流；而 token 价格六周跌 21%、用量创新高，则印证了单位经济模型正在快速恶化。技术侧，扩散语言模型（英伟达收购 Inception、开源 Sigma）与“模型改写自身权重”两条非主流路线同时获得实质进展，值得开发者提前布局实验。另一个被低估的变化是平台层的封闭化：苹果自研 Agent 并抬高门槛、Signal 屏蔽截图、OpenAI 强化防蒸馏，Agent 生态的开放红利期可能正在收窄。最后，黎曼猜想事件提醒我们，AI 产出的高影响力成果将越来越需要独立的验证机制，而不是靠发布方的声明。

items.title: Anthropic IPO 首日破发，纳斯达克回吐 2026 全年涨幅
items.desc: Anthropic 以 111.50 美元开盘（发行价 83 美元），随后股价大跌，带动 AI 板块约 4 万亿美元市值蒸发，纳指 100 进入技术性熊市；7 位创始人合计套现近 20 亿美元。
items.value: 一级市场高估值与二级市场定价出现明显脱节，融资与估值预期需重估

items.title: Anthropic 数学家称与 Claude 合作证明黎曼猜想，人类数学家同期也宣布证明
items.desc: Levent Alpöge 称与 Claude 一起发现黎曼猜想的证明，并已形式化；几乎同时，Ravi Vakil 宣布 Alessandro Masullo 的纯人类 GRH 证明草稿即将公开。陶哲轩、邓煜等数学家公开回应，态度审慎。
items.value: 若验证通过，将是 AI 参与数学研究的标志性事件，但当前应保持审慎

items.title: OpenAI 大幅加固 GPT-6.2 推理防提取，成功率从 54% 降至 0.2%
items.desc: OpenAI 对 Astra 与 Sol 两个模型加强推理链保护，每周封禁数千至数万个参与协同蒸馏的账号。
items.value: 模型能力提取攻防升级，蒸馏类业务与 API 滥用风险显著上升

items.title: 苹果被曝自研可操控 Mac 的 AI Agent，同时抬高竞品接入门槛
items.desc: 继 Meta、OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 之后，苹果加入设备级 Agent 竞赛，并收紧第三方对 iOS/macOS 的访问。
items.value: 系统级 Agent 入口争夺战开启，第三方 Agent 的分发渠道可能受限

items.title: 英伟达拟以至少 5 亿美元收购扩散语言模型公司 Inception
items.desc: Inception 成立仅两年，做的是基于扩散过程、而非逐 token 生成的语言模型，用于补强 Nemotron 开源模型线与机器人方向。
items.value: 扩散语言模型路线获得巨头背书，非自回归生成值得关注

items.title: Signal 在 iOS/Android 上屏蔽截图，阻止系统级 AI Agent 读取聊天
items.desc: Signal 称 Siri AI、Gemini Intelligence、Meta Muse 等屏幕理解能力构成“生存威胁”，但承认 macOS 端防护仍不完整。
items.value: Agent 读屏与隐私边界首次正面冲突，产品设计需考虑合规

items.title: Gemini for Mac 上线 Computer Use，可在后台窗口操作桌面应用
items.desc: Gemini 能在隔离的后台窗口中操作 Mac 应用、本地文件与网页，同时提供实时预览，用户可继续正常工作。
items.value: 桌面自动化 Agent 进入可用阶段，办公类 Agent 产品形态将被重塑

items.title: Google 搜索首页加入 AI 对话侧边栏，搜索进一步转向“答案引擎”
items.desc: 桌面版首页全球上线可折叠 AI 侧栏，支持继续历史 AI 搜索、创建 notebook，并推出不留痕的临时会话。
items.value: 搜索流量入口再分配，SEO 与内容分发策略需重新评估

items.title: Google 员工联名请愿，要求公司不要惩罚拒绝 AI 的学校
items.desc: Alphabet 工会组织员工请愿，反对公司对不愿引入 Gemini 的教育机构施压，HN 讨论热度居当日前列。
items.value: AI 进校园的伦理与商业推广大战，教育市场落地阻力显性化

items.title: Ramp 数据：模型 token 价格六周跌 21%，用量创新高但收入增速放缓
items.desc: Ramp、Stripe、OpenRouter 三方数据交叉验证同一趋势，Anthropic 占据近 59% 的 token 支出份额。
items.value: 单位价格快速下降、用量上升，AI 应用毛利与定价模型需重算

items.title: 华为云开源昇腾原生具身世界模型 CloudRobo-WM1.2，两项评测均列第一
items.desc: 基于昇腾算力训练，华为云同时开放整套 CloudRobo 底座，并允许一批算力轮流服务多家公司。
items.value: 国产算力具身方案走向开放，创业团队可降低自建训练底座的成本

items.title: 腾讯姚顺雨团队回应算力不足、刷榜质疑，并透露下一代混元模型
items.desc: 团队深夜集中回应外界关切，下一代混元模型露出冰山一角，并提及“雷霆大思考”。
items.value: 国内头部团队对算力与评测争议的公开表态，可作为观察混元路线的信号

items.title: Bloomberg 分析千万条招聘：中国 AI 暴露岗位降幅快 10 个百分点
items.desc: 入门级岗位与创意行业受冲击最大，目前超 90% 的微短剧已由 AI 生产。
items.value: AI 对就业结构的实际影响开始有量化证据

items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights（self-rewriting）
items.desc: 模型仅凭自身推理、无梯度、无训练即可改写自身权重以提升表现，延续“大模型编辑小模型权重”的路线。
items.value: 为部署后自进化提供新范式，可能改变微调与推理时计算的边界

items.title: A CPU Inside an LLM：零梯度将精确电路编译进预训练权重
items.desc: 用闭式、零样本、零运行时 hook 的方式把确定性计算直接“嫁接”进预训练权重，同时约束归一化漂移并保留自然语言能力。
items.value: 无需微调即可让 LLM 精确做多位数算术，工具调用可部分内化

items.title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure：审计仿真操作 benchmark 的成功判定器
items.desc: 发现手写 success checker 会接受不完整执行（幻影成功），也会拒绝合规执行（静默失败），直接影响策略评测结论的可信度。
items.value: 具身/操作类 benchmark 的结论可能系统性失真，评测需重审

items.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.desc: 实验表明，扩散 Transformer 的 RL 后训练收益在很大程度上可由一个与输入无关的激活偏移解释。
items.value: RL 后训练机制被简化，扩散模型对齐成本有望大幅下降

items.title: Embeddings vs. Grep：重审代码检索中的稠密优势
items.desc: 构建真实仓库级代码检索 benchmark Repo-Premium（6 种语言、2022–2026 PR），指出既有 benchmark 的稠密优势被高估。
items.value: coding agent 的检索层选型应重新评估，grep 未必落后

items.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
items.desc: 现有 VLA 即使能在初始状态抑制任务，中途接管仍可能完成被禁止的行为，论文提出安全中止与物理响应控制方法。
items.value: 机器人安全护栏需覆盖执行中段，而非仅做任务拒绝

items.title: TwinLab-Bench：在真实实验室的 Agent 孪生体中评测 AI 科学家
items.desc: 要求 Agent 不仅执行给定流程、选择下一步测量，还要自行设计实验并可靠执行。
items.value: AI scientist 评测从“跑流程”推进到“自主设计实验”

items.title: Twice-Told Critiques：LLM 时代同行评审在 claim 层面同质化
items.desc: ICLR 评审意见重叠度从 2026 年的 12.0% 升至 2027 年的 21.3%，第三位审稿人新增问题数下降。
items.value: LLM 辅助审稿正在削弱评审多样性，学术评价体系面临新问题

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron-Labs-Sigma：14 个 3B/8B 连续扩散语言模型 checkpoint
items.desc: 在 16 维学习嵌入空间去噪，蒸馏出少步采样器，解码速度最高达自回归的 4.20 倍。
items.value: 扩散 LM 有可直接使用的开源权重，长文本生成吞吐可显著提升

items.title: RadixArk DaisyRose-27B：仅用 RL 后训练的 Agentic Coding 模型
items.desc: 基于 Qwen3.8-27B，Apache 2.0，Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 从基线提升逾一倍至 12.0，单卡可跑。
items.value: 单卡可部署的 agentic coding 模型，后训练效率路线可复现

items.title: Agnes：双系统决策 + 双层自进化，Agent 效率最高提升 14 倍、成本降至 1/27
items.desc: 团队已开源 Agnes Harness。
items.value: Agent 推理成本可下降一个数量级，适合高频调用场景

items.title: HuggingFace 推出 harness adapters：把模型适配到你的 harness 以提升性能与成本
items.desc: 面向大规模场景，让同一模型在不同 agent harness 下获得更优表现。
items.value: 模型与 harness 解耦适配，Agent 工程调优有了标准化手段

items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre：面向 CI/CD 可靠性的开源 Agent
items.desc: 单日 GitHub 新增 466 star。
items.value: Agent 落地运维场景，CI 故障定位可自动化

items.title: openvinotoolkit/openvino：单日 +217 star
items.desc: 开源推理优化与部署工具包，持续活跃。
items.value: 端侧与异构硬件部署的成熟路径

items.title: 黎曼猜想“AI 证明”与“人类证明”撞车，数学家集体降温
items.desc: Levent Alpöge 宣称与 Claude 证明黎曼猜想并已形式化，同日 Ravi Vakil 宣布 Masullo 的纯人类 GRH 证明草稿将提前公开。邓煜直言“干到 500 页之前看都不看”，社区争论焦点在于：AI 参与的形式化证明应如何被验证与署名。
items.value: AI for Math 的成果验证标准与学术信用分配亟待建立

items.title: “token 欺诈”成独立开发者公开讨论的新问题
items.desc: ChatPRD 创始人 Claire Vo 披露免费试用被大规模滥用、token 被转售，损失达数万美元，最终关停免费试用；Simon Willison 转发后引发广泛讨论。
items.value: AI 产品免费额度的滥用成本被低估，风控需前置设计

en.headline: Anthropic IPO breaks issue price on debut, Nasdaq erases 2026 gains
headline_alt: AI sector loses $4 trillion in market value
Seven Anthropic founders cash out nearly $2 billion
en.observation: The core signal today is that "both valuations and capabilities are being repriced at the same time": Anthropic broke issue price on its first trading day, and the Nasdaq gave back its year-to-date gains, showing that capital markets are starting to price AI based on cash flow rather than narrative; meanwhile, token prices fell 21% in six weeks while usage hit a new high, confirming that unit economics are deteriorating rapidly. On the technology side, two non-mainstream routes—diffusion language models (NVIDIA acquiring Inception, open-sourcing Sigma) and "models rewriting their own weights"—both made substantive progress at the same time, and developers should start experimenting early. Another underappreciated change is the closing of the platform layer: Apple building its own Agent and raising the barrier, Signal blocking screenshots, and OpenAI strengthening anti-distillation—the open dividend period for the Agent ecosystem may be narrowing. Finally, the Riemann Hypothesis incident reminds us that high-impact results produced by AI will increasingly require independent verification mechanisms rather than relying on the publisher's claims.

items.title: Anthropic IPO breaks issue price on day one, Nasdaq gives back all of 2026's gains
items.desc: Anthropic opened at $111.50 (issue price $83), then shares plunged, wiping out roughly $4 trillion in AI sector market value and pushing the Nasdaq 100 into a technical bear market; the seven founders collectively cashed out nearly $2 billion.
items.value: Private-market valuations and public pricing are clearly out of sync; funding and valuation expectations need reassessment

items.title: Anthropic mathematician claims Riemann Hypothesis proof with Claude, while human mathematicians announce their own proof at the same time
items.desc: Levent Alpöge says he discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis together with Claude and has formalized it; almost simultaneously, Ravi Vakil announced that Alessandro Masullo's purely human GRH proof draft will soon be made public. Mathematicians including Terence Tao and Deng Yu responded publicly with caution.
items.value: If verified, a landmark case of AI in mathematical research, but caution is warranted now

items.title: OpenAI substantially hardens GPT-6.2 reasoning against extraction, success rate drops from 54% to 0.2%
items.desc: OpenAI strengthened reasoning-chain protection for its Astra and Sol models, banning thousands to tens of thousands of accounts per week involved in coordinated distillation.
items.value: Model-capability extraction attack/defense escalates; distillation businesses and API abuse risks rise sharply

items.title: Apple reportedly developing its own AI agent that can control a Mac, while raising barriers for competitors
items.desc: Following Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, Apple joins the device-level agent race and tightens third-party access to iOS/macOS.
items.value: The battle for the system-level agent entry point begins; third-party agent distribution channels may be restricted

items.title: Nvidia to acquire diffusion language model company Inception for at least $500 million
items.desc: Inception, founded just two years ago, builds language models based on a diffusion process rather than token-by-token generation, to bolster the Nemotron open-source model line and robotics efforts.
items.value: The diffusion language model approach gains big-tech backing; non-autoregressive generation is worth watching

items.title: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS/Android to stop system-level AI agents from reading chats
items.desc: Signal says screen-understanding capabilities such as Siri AI, Gemini Intelligence, and Meta Muse pose an "existential threat," but admits macOS protection remains incomplete.
items.value: Agent screen-reading and privacy boundaries clash head-on for the first time; product design must consider compliance

items.title: Gemini for Mac launches Computer Use, can operate desktop apps in background windows
items.desc: Gemini can operate Mac apps, local files, and web pages in an isolated background window while providing a live preview, so users can keep working normally.
items.value: Desktop automation agents become usable; office agent product forms will be reshaped

items.title: Google adds an AI chat sidebar to its search homepage, pushing search further toward an "answer engine"
items.desc: A collapsible AI sidebar rolls out globally on the desktop homepage, supporting continuation of past AI searches, notebook creation, and a new incognito temporary session.
items.value: Search traffic entry points are redistributed; SEO and content distribution strategies need re-evaluation

items.title: Google employees sign petition asking the company not to punish schools that refuse AI
items.desc: Alphabet's union organized an employee petition opposing company pressure on educational institutions unwilling to adopt Gemini; the HN discussion ranked among the top of the day.
items.value: The ethics and commercial-promotion battle over AI in schools; resistance in the education market becomes visible

items.title: Ramp data: model token prices fall 21% in six weeks, usage hits record high but revenue growth slows
items.desc: Data from Ramp, Stripe, and OpenRouter cross-validate the same trend; Anthropic accounts for nearly 59% of token spending share.
items.value: Unit prices fall fast while usage rises; AI app margins and pricing models need recalculation

items.title: Huawei Cloud open-sources Ascend-native embodied world model CloudRobo-WM1.2, ranks first on both benchmarks
items.desc: Trained on Ascend compute, Huawei Cloud also opened the full CloudRobo foundation and allows a pool of compute to serve multiple companies in rotation.
items.value: A domestic-compute embodied solution goes open; startups can lower the cost of building their own training foundation

items.title: Tencent's Yao Shunyu team responds to compute-shortage and benchmark-gaming questions, hints at next-gen Hunyuan model
items.desc: The team addressed outside concerns in a late-night集中 response, offering a glimpse of the next-generation Hunyuan model and mentioning "Thunder Big Thinking."
items.value: A leading domestic team's public stance on compute and evaluation disputes; a signal for the Hunyuan roadmap

items.title: Bloomberg analysis of 10 million job postings: AI-exposed roles in China fell 10 percentage points faster
items.desc: Entry-level positions and creative industries were hit hardest; over 90% of short micro-dramas are now AI-produced.
items.value: Quantified evidence of AI's real impact on employment structure is emerging

items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights (self-rewriting)
items.desc: Models can rewrite their own weights to improve performance using only their own reasoning—no gradients, no training—continuing the line of "large models editing small-model weights."
items.value: Offers a new paradigm for post-deployment self-evolution, potentially reshaping fine-tuning and inference-time compute boundaries

items.title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
items.desc: Deterministic computation is "grafted" directly into pretrained weights via a closed-form, zero-shot, zero-runtime-hook approach, while constraining normalization drift and preserving natural language ability.
items.value: Lets LLMs do exact multi-digit arithmetic without fine-tuning; tool calls can be partially internalized

items.title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing Success Checkers in Manipulation Simulation Benchmarks
items.desc: Hand-written success checkers are found to accept incomplete executions (phantom success) and reject compliant executions (silent failure), directly undermining the credibility of policy evaluation conclusions.
items.value: Embodied/manipulation benchmark conclusions may be systematically distorted; evaluation needs re-examination

items.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.desc: Experiments show that the gains from RL post-training in diffusion Transformers can be largely explained by an input-independent activation shift.
items.value: Simplifies the RL post-training mechanism; diffusion model alignment costs could drop sharply

items.title: Embeddings vs. Grep: Revisiting the Dense Advantage in Code Retrieval
items.desc: Builds Repo-Premium, a real repository-level code retrieval benchmark (6 languages, 2022–2026 PRs), and shows that the dense advantage in existing benchmarks is overestimated.
items.value: Coding agent retrieval-layer choices should be re-evaluated; grep may not be behind

items.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
items.desc: Existing VLAs may still complete prohibited behaviors when taking over mid-task even if they can suppress the task at the initial state; the paper proposes safe abort and physical response control methods.
items.value: Robot safety guardrails must cover mid-execution, not just task refusal

items.title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agent Twins of Real Laboratories
items.desc: Requires agents not only to execute given procedures and choose the next measurement, but also to design experiments themselves and execute them reliably.
items.value: AI scientist evaluation advances from "running procedures" to "autonomously designing experiments"

items.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Peer Review in the LLM Era Is Homogenizing at the Claim Level
items.desc: ICLR review overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, and the number of new issues raised by the third reviewer declined.
items.value: LLM-assisted reviewing is eroding review diversity; academic evaluation faces new problems

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron-Labs-Sigma: 14 3B/8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints
items.desc: Denoises in a 16-dimensional learned embedding space, distills a few-step sampler, and reaches decoding speeds up to 4.20x that of autoregressive models.
items.value: Diffusion LMs now have ready-to-use open weights, boosting long-text generation throughput

items.title: RadixArk DaisyRose-27B: an agentic coding model trained with RL post-training only
items.desc: Built on Qwen3.8-27B under Apache 2.0; Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 more than doubles from baseline to 12.0, and it runs on a single GPU.
items.value: A single-GPU deployable agentic coding model with a reproducible post-training recipe

items.title: Agnes: dual-system decision-making + two-layer self-evolution, boosting agent efficiency up to 14x and cutting cost to 1/27
items.desc: The team has open-sourced Agnes Harness.
items.value: Agent inference cost can drop by an order of magnitude, suiting high-frequency calls

items.title: HuggingFace launches harness adapters: adapt models to your harness for better performance and cost
items.desc: Aimed at large-scale scenarios, letting the same model perform better under different agent harnesses.
items.value: Decoupled model-harness adaptation gives agent engineering a standardized tuning method

items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre: an open-source agent for CI/CD reliability
items.desc: Gained 466 GitHub stars in a single day.
items.value: Agents enter ops scenarios, automating CI failure diagnosis

items.title: openvinotoolkit/openvino: +217 stars in a single day
items.desc: An open-source inference optimization and deployment toolkit, consistently active.
items.value: A mature path for edge and heterogeneous hardware deployment

items.title: Riemann Hypothesis "AI proof" and "human proof" collide, mathematicians collectively cool down
items.desc: Levent Alpöge claimed to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis with Claude and formalized it, while on the same day Ravi Vakil announced that Masullo's purely human GRH proof draft would be released early. Deng Yu said bluntly, "I won't even look at it until it's 500 pages," and the community debate centers on: how AI-involved formalized proofs should be verified and credited.
items.value: Verification standards and academic credit allocation for AI for Math results urgently need to be established

items.title: "Token fraud" becomes a new issue openly discussed by indie developers
items.desc: ChatPRD founder Claire Vo disclosed that free trials were massively abused and tokens were resold, with losses reaching tens of thousands of dollars, ultimately leading to the shutdown of free trials; Simon Willison's repost sparked widespread discussion.
items.value: The abuse cost of free AI product quotas is underestimated; risk controls need front-loaded design
